title: Opening of reel one and Schiro's birth
summary: Interviewer tests the tape, gives date and address; Schiro says he was born in New Orleans 24 September 1911.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Let's get your name. The first thing, just to test it out. What's your name? Luke Skiro. Luke Skiro?
And this is the first reel. What's today's date? Is it December the...
So, you want to tell me where you were born and when? Just to start off?
Well, I was born in New Orleans in 1911, September 24th.
Well, you're still a young man. You're not like some of the musicians. I see it, right?
Well, I'm 56 years old. I just made 56. Mm-hmm.
